results.title: ACASI - African Centre for Agriculture and Social Inclusion
results.content: ACASI – African Centre for Agriculture and Social Inclusion ###### African Centre for Agriculture and Social Inclusion (ACASI) Empowering Agriculture for a Sustainable Future in Africa Sowing the seeds of progress in African agriculture. We’re committed to nurturing sustainable growth and inclusivity in farming, and our story is one of dedication, collaboration, and a passion for positive change. #### Year founded #### Board Members #### Focal Points ##### Our mission Acasi, which stands for African Center for Agriculture and Social Inclusion was established on April 18, 2018, as a registered non-governmental organization under the Nigerian Company and Allied Matters Act. Our organization serves as Nigeria’s leading center for agri-food resources, dedicated to supporting communities, government agencies, and budding agripreneurs in starting, accelerating, and scaling diverse staple and export value chains, sustainably. ACASI is governed by a 4 (four)- member board of directors comprised of experienced professionals with expertise in agriculture, food security, international trade, public service, and the green economy. #### Our Mission We are passionately dedicated to establishing a secure and inclusive path for millions of Africans and individuals in the diaspora, to access and benefit from sustainable, high-quality Agri-food resources, empowering them to cultivate, trade, and nourish their communities in an environmentally conscious manner. #### Our Vision To frontier in judicious Agri-food management and distribution across Africa, ensuring efficient utilization of resources, promoting sustainability, and enhancing food accessibility ##### Our values #### Feeding and Outreach In Africa, we address various challenges, such as interethnic/religious conflicts, terrorism, climate change, and the recent impact of COVID-19 on farming communities. #### Affirmative Climate Action: ACASI is dedicated to creating a sustainable future for Agribusiness. #### Agri Advocacy: Women & Youth African women and youth play a crucial role in smallholder farming and sustaining food SMEs. We are committed to providing quality support to their livelihoods through various media outlets and initiatives. #### Policy Guide / Framework Bi-annually, our group of professional think tanks across board, study the sector with country Focus, with a view to providing policy directives and implementation guide to fire up actions in sustainable Agriculture and Food security.
